import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
root=Path('/private/tmp/fq-application-gap-study-20261122/docs/development/evidence');source=root/'compiler-layer-projection-screen.json';index=json.loads(source.read_text());p={k:v for k,v in index.items() if k not in ('row_files','original_observation_sha256')};items=[]
for ref in index['row_files']:
 data=(root/ref['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==ref['sha256'];values=json.loads(data);assert len(values)==ref['row_count'];items.extend(values)
assert sorted(v['position'] for v in items)==list(range(120));p['rows']=[v['row'] for v in sorted(items,key=lambda x:x['position'])];original=(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n').encode();assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==index['original_observation_sha256'];assert p['completed']
bundle=Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'));seen=set();maximum=0
for row in p['rows']:
 key=(row['case'],row['workflow'],row['seed']);assert key not in seen;seen.add(key);width,family,topology=row['case'].split('/');width=int(width);f=fixture(width,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce']);metrics=routing(row['payload'],f,None,bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}'],0);assert metrics==row['metrics'] and row['status']=='accepted';maximum=max(maximum,metrics['max_semantic_error'])
expected={(f'{n:02d}/{family}/{topology}',workflow,11) for n in WIDTHS for family in FAMILIES for topology in TOPOLOGIES for workflow in ('flagquantum-ordinary-restored','flagquantum-target-artifact')};assert seen==expected
assert not {'flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'}.intersection(sys.modules)
proof={'evidence_class':'development','source_commit':p['source_commit'],'screen_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'original_observation_sha256':index['original_observation_sha256'],'exact_original_bytes_reconstructed':True,'candidate_rows_replayed':len(seen),'producer_sdks_imported':False,'max_semantic_error':maximum,'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text()};(root/'compiler-layer-projection-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='script_source'}))
